source_limitations: Official Oxford 3000 by CEFR level PDF directly inspected 2026-10-30. One-based PDF pages and zero-based web extracted lines. Twelve publisher A1 word/POS observations only, not independent exact-sense labels. Rice cooked/uncooked Myanmar distinction, chicken animal/meat, countability, and verb polysemy require independent editorial decisions. The A1 rabbit entry was not included in this packet because no rabbit noun entry was located in the inspected Oxford 3000 PDF; absence is not a CEFR classification. No English, Myanmar, example, CEFR, George/Emma listening, physical iPhone, hosting or deployment approval.
